text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото has yet to show up to
training, so I
decide to search for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Th-the energy from the cosmos gives
you
p-positivity? And you say the results
are
permanent?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I never knew a p-product so amazing
could be
real! I'll take one please!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, so you would like to purchase the
cosmic
wristband. Now, how will you be
paying?
text_block_list.name: Suspicious Lady
choice_data_list: Are you sure this does what you say?

text_block_list.text:
Gyah, Тренер?! What are you doing
here?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh, ho, ho, ho! I must take my leave, for
I have
now remembered my very tight
and busy
schedule!
text_block_list.name: Suspicious Lady

text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! But what about my cosmic
wristband?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list:
You should be more concerned that it's your
training time.

text_block_list.text: I completely forgot! I'm s-so sorry!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I remind Мэйсё Дото to be more
cognizant of
her training schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
